result.instructions: Tools for ElevenLabs, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many characters do I have left this month, and when do they reset?"; "Which voices in my account are cloned, and which are premade?"; "Show me my last 10 speech generations and which voice made each one.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ElevenLabs data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run elevenlabs_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run elevenlabs_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run elevenlabs_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. elevenlabs_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_user_info
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: Get the account behind the API key: user id, workspace id, first name, and whether onboarding is complete. Good first call to confirm which account is connected. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/user.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription and usage
tools.description: Get the plan tier, character usage and limit, when the character count resets, voice slots used and allowed, and billing status. Use it before large generation jobs. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/user/subscription.

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the speech models of the ElevenLabs API, with each model id and name. Use a model id from here in speech history filters. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/models.

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_voices
tools.title: List voices
tools.description: List voices in this account's library: id, name, category, labels, and preview URL. Filter by search text, voice type or category. Returns next_page_token when more voices exist. ElevenLabs API: GET /v2/voices.

search.description: Match voice names, descriptions and labels.

voice_type.description: Voice type filter (for example personal, community, default).

category.description: Voice category filter (for example premade, cloned, generated, professional).

next_page_token.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page (next_page_token or start_after_history_item_id).

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_voice
tools.title: Get a voice
tools.description: Get one voice by id: name, category, labels, description, sharing state, and verified languages. Set with_settings to include its default generation settings. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}.

with_settings.description: Include the voice's generation settings in the reply.

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_voice_settings
tools.title: Get voice settings
tools.description: Get the generation settings of one voice: stability, similarity boost, style, speed, speaker boost. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}/settings.

tools.name: elevenlabs_search_shared_voices
tools.title: Search the shared voice library
tools.description: Search the public ElevenLabs voice library: name, gender, age, accent, language, use cases and usage count. Use it to find a voice id to add to the account. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/shared-voices.

search.description: Free-text search over voice names and descriptions.

age.description: Age filter (for example young, middle_aged, old).

language.description: Language filter (ISO code, for example en).

tools.name: elevenlabs_list_speech_history
tools.title: List speech history
tools.description: List past speech generations on this account: history item id, voice, model, text, date, and character count change. Filter by voice, model, text search or date. Returns last_history_item_id to page on. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/history.

voice_id.description: Only items made with this voice id.

model_id.description: Only items made with this model id.

search.description: Text search over the generated text.

date_before_unix.description: Only items created before this Unix time (seconds).

date_after_unix.description: Only items created after this Unix time (seconds).

sort_direction.description: Sort by date (default desc, newest first).

start_after_history_item_id.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page (next_page_token or start_after_history_item_id).

tools.name: elevenlabs_get_speech_history_item
tools.title: Get a speech history item
tools.description: Get one speech history item by id: text, voice, model, output format, settings, state and date. The audio itself is not returned. ElevenLabs API: GET /v1/history/{history_item_id}.

tools.name: elevenlabs_delete_speech_history_item
tools.title: Delete a speech history item
tools.description: Delete one speech history item from this account. The generated audio for that item is removed and cannot be recovered. ElevenLabs API: DELETE /v1/history/{history_item_id}.

prompts.title: Get started with ElevenLabs
prompts.description: What you can do with ElevenLabs here, with example requests to try.
